newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Morococha stock jumps 10.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Morococha stock jumps 10.2 pct.

text.p: Peruvian polymetallic miner Morococha's labor stock rallied 10.2 percent in early trading Wednesday on the Lima Stock Exchange, buoyed by strong metal prices and healthy investment and growth projections, traders said.
By 1120 local time/1220 EDT/1620 GMT, the share was trading at 4.43 soles after opening at 4.02 soles, according to figures from the Lima bolsa.
"The stock is rising for various reasons, including the arrival of U.S. miner Phelps Dodge as a partner," said trader Manuel Torres at brokerage Finvest.

Morococha, whose share price closed up 8.02 percent on Tuesday, announced last week that Phelps Dodge had bought a 27 percent stake in the firm. That news has brought expectations of increased investment and profitability.
Peruvian mining stocks have been on a bullish run since the start of the year, rising 104 percent, according to the Lima Stock Exchange.
